description_for_human: Instant zero-disk SVG wireframe placeholder generator with custom dimensions, hex colors, and label text.
description_for_model: Use placeholger to generate placeholder image URLs or inline SVG wireframes for HTML, Markdown, React, or UI prototypes. Format: https://placeholger.hellinger.wtf/{w}/{h}/{bg_hex}/{fg_hex}?text={label}&dims={0|1} where w and h are integers between 1 and 2048.
